proposals.before: Tianzuo, mindful that Wuna was a senior minister of Daozong's reign who had helped settle the succession, often consulted him on policy; Wuna answered without reserve.
proposals.after: Tianzuo, mindful that Wuna was a senior minister of the former reign who had helped settle the succession, often consulted him on policy; Wuna answered without reserve.
proposals.reason: The Chinese reads 先朝, 'former reign,' and does not explicitly name Daozong in this unit.

decisions.reason: s0043 has 先朝重臣, which means a senior minister of the former reign; the Chinese does not name 道宗 here, so 'Daozong's reign' invents a proper name absent from the unit, and 'the former reign' restores the source wording.
